title: Tipping Terms for Cartwise Grocery Orders Shoppers
content:
## Tipping terms

These terms govern the shopper tip on a Cartwise Grocery Orders order, at checkout and after completion.

### Clauses

1. Only service levels on which tips are allowed carry a tip.
2. The checkout tip defaults to the service level's default tip percentage of the item subtotal, and the customer may change it before checkout.
3. The whole tip passes to the shopper; Cartwise keeps none of it.
4. After completion the tip can be changed at most the service level's allowed number of post-completion tip changes, and only within the tip edit window counted from the order's completion. The window is counted in elapsed hours from the completion time, and the last moment to change is the completion time plus the service level's tip edit window hours, inclusive.
5. A single increase may not exceed the service level's largest single tip increase, and a reduction may not bring the tip below 0.00.
6. A tip is never reduced by the agent on the customer's behalf without the customer confirming the new amount, and a tip reduction is never used to fund an item refund.
7. Each tip change passes to the shopper's batch at once.

The number of tip changes after completion is the count of tip increases and tip reductions recorded on the order after its completion time. The completion time is read from the order record.

### The edit window at its boundary (hypothetical figures)

An order completed at 18:30 on one day; for this illustration the service level's tip edit window is 24 hours, so the last moment to change the tip is 18:30 the next day.

| Moment of the change | Within the window |
|---|---|
| 18:29 the next day | Yes |
| 18:30 the next day exactly | Yes — the last moment is inclusive |
| 18:31 the next day | No |

### Points of judgement

| Situation after completion | Position |
|---|---|
| Changes already made equal the service level's allowed number | No further change |
| Requested increase larger than the service level's largest single increase | Not accepted as a single increase |
| Requested reduction larger than the current tip | Not accepted; the tip cannot go below 0.00 |
| Customer asks that a tip reduction pay for a missing item | Not done; a tip reduction never funds an item refund |
| Tip changed within the window and the allowed number | Passes to the shopper's batch at once |
